import pandas as pd

    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "HID": [123408, 123408, 123481, 123481, 123481],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"]*5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"],
    "Rasse2Text": ["Labrador Retriever"]*2 + [""]*3,
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

# Create a DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Initialize the figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a barplot
sns.barplot(data=df, x="StichtagDatJahr", y="AnzHunde", hue="KreisLang", palette="viridis")

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and Kreis')
